content: {"episode_id":"ep-05160","cpt":"93247","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the PR-204 denial of CPT 93247, long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring, for this episode. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness that have persisted despite initial management for supraventricular tachycardia, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes I47.1 and R42. As the note states, the study is indicated to further characterize the arrhythmia and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances. We therefore request reconsideration of the determination that this service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan."}
